# How Kalpa uses marketing-psychology (MIT, unmodified copy)

Use it for offers, landing pages, pricing pages, pilot pitches and ad copy (Kavi, Echo, Deals agents; Claude reviews).
Kalpa rules win where they differ:
- **Opt-in only.** Ignore any advice to pre-select subscriptions or use opt-out defaults: WhatsApp Business policy and DPDP require clear, active opt-in (CLAUDE.md rule 4). No pre-ticked consent boxes.
- **No dark patterns:** no fake scarcity or countdowns, no fake "only 2 left", no confirm-shaming, no hidden costs, no invented reviews or numbers (UX-PATTERNS #14: no dark patterns; ASCI).
- Real scarcity is fine when true (e.g. "first 50 founding buyers" if we actually cap it) and must be enforced in code.
- Every persuasive line must still be true: never claim more than is built (rule 18 Oct: the site must not claim more than is built).
